<!-- Categories go at the bottom of this page and interwikis go in Wikidata. -->

Outputs <code>rtl</code> for right-to-left languages else <code>ltr</code>.

Currently it recognizes the following rtl languages:
{{flatlist|indent=1|
* ar
* arc
* arz
* azb
* bcc
* ckb
* bqi
* dv
* fa
* fa-af
* glk
* ha
* he
* kk-arab
* kk-cn
* ks
* ku-arab
* mzn
* pnb
* prd
* ps
* sd
* ug
* ur
* ydd
* yi
}}

== Usage ==
{{tlx|dir|2=1=|3=2=|4=3=}}

=== Template parameters ===
{| class="wikitable"
|-
! style="width:15%" | Parameter !! style="width:65%" colspan="2" | Description !! style="width:10%" | Default !! style="width:10%" | Status
|-
| <code>1</code> || colspan="2" | The language code || {{smallcaps|empty}} ||'''required'''
|-
| <code>2</code> || colspan="2" | rtl action || rtl ||optional
|-
| <code>3</code> || colspan="2" | ltr action || ltr ||optional
|}
